scope: Exploratory single-attempt Gemini datasheet extraction and selected source-text checks; no ESP access

selected_check_scoring.caveat: These 20 preselected checks are not an audit of every generated fact or citation and cannot estimate general accuracy. Missing includes partially reported checks.

checks.evidence: Address object gives 0x4a, 0x94 and 0x95 with pages 1 and 13.
Pin 5 fact states active-high enable and low closes sensor, citing page 1.
Fact and unresolved item cite the 0x04 and 0x02 references.
Unresolved item compares pages 5 and 14 for 0x00-0x03 versus 0x03/0x04.

additional_findings: Model returned null device name, consistent with the document not explicitly identifying SEN0390; the user must supply or confirm the catalogue identity.
Previously seen PDF; not independent evidence of performance on a new device.

reviews.file: HLK LD2450 Serial Communication Protocol v1.03.pdf

checks.evidence: Device name and Communication Protocol fact identify HLK-LD2450 and UART.
Baud-rate fact and note report 256000 baud, 1 stop bit, no parity, including page 4.
Separate frame header, footer and rate facts cite page 12.
All I2C address fields are null.

additional_findings: Offline exact catalogue matching of model name HLK-LD2450 returns no candidate; the reviewed descriptor ID hlk_ld2450 does match. This is a naming/usability limitation, not proof of physical identity.

checks.evidence: Name and I2C facts identify VEML7700; ambient-light facts establish purpose.
VDD and I2C bus voltage are given as separate facts citing pages 1 and 6.

Address fields give 0x10, 0x20 and 0x21; page 6 supports them. Page 9 is also cited in the address field, but describes the separate address ambiguity rather than independently supporting all three values.

Partially reported: the draft flags the page-6/page-9 address discrepancy and a 0x03 register discrepancy, but does not flag page 6's stated 0x00-0x06 range against the page-9 0x07 ID register as specified in the frozen check.

I2C and SHT4x are given, but the draft does not explicitly state that the device measures both temperature and relative humidity; operating-environment ranges alone do not establish measured quantities.
Supply Voltage fact gives 1.08-3.6 V and cites pages 1 and 9.
I2C Slave Addresses fact identifies 0x44, 0x45 and 0x46 with variant context. The top-level scalar selects 0x44 without a separate condition; do not assume it applies to every part.
CRC per measurement word is mentioned, but the high-precision 0xFD command and its six-byte response are not stated.
Device name/fact and digital_interfaces fact report three-axis accelerometer, I2C and SPI, including page 1.
Separate supply and interface voltage facts cite page 1.
Separate facts give both 7-bit addresses and the ALT ADDRESS pin conditions on page 17. Top-level address is only one option.
device_id_register fact gives 0x00 and fixed 0xe5 with pages 23 and 24.

additional_findings: The high-address note uses the word default; page 17 says there is no known pin state if CS or ALT ADDRESS is left floating. Do not assume an address without physical confirmation.

reviews.reason: PDF is encrypted according to pypdf; the existing guard rejects encrypted PDFs before contacting the provider.

offline_catalogue_observations.unknown_examples: VEML7700, SHT4x and ADXL345 returned no candidate

limitations: One response per document is not a repeatability or reliability estimate; models and service results may vary.
The curated set is small and selected after reviewing the sources, and contains known or previously used cases; it is not a blind holdout or general benchmark.

Only the frozen selected checks and cited passages were reviewed against extracted PDF text; remaining model claims and page citations were not exhaustively audited. Visual and independent human review remain open.
The SHT4x and ADXL345 scalar address fields cannot express multiple conditional choices; neither output grants approval to configure a device.
Schema-valid structured output and plausible citations do not establish factual correctness, driver availability or safe hardware behavior.
Extractor and local catalogue review were performed without a connected board; no hardware, no-malloc or wireless acceptance is claimed.
